version.changelog: Tighten AI-code pre-merge review workflow: stricter evidence handling, risk calibration, security/privacy pass, paste-mode rules, and validation reporting.

llm.summary: This is a focused code-review skill that asks the agent to inspect visible code changes and validation evidence before giving a merge recommendation.

dimensions.detail: The skill may have the agent inspect local or GitHub repository context and run a small validation gate when tools are available, which is expected for code review but should be used with normal caution on untrusted repositories.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifact is a single Markdown skill file with no bundled executable scripts, dependencies, installer, or remote payload retrieval.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The role and output-format instructions are scoped to producing a structured review; they do not attempt to override platform safety rules, hide behavior, or manipulate unrelated agent behavior.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No persistence, privilege escalation, credential harvesting, background workers, memory modification, or tool wrapping behavior is present in the artifact.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The skill's stated purpose is pre-merge review of AI-generated or agent-written code, and its instructions stay aligned with correctness, security/privacy, scope, dependency, and validation review.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install this if you want stricter pre-merge reviews. Be aware that it encourages repository inspection and possibly running tests or build checks, so review commands before execution when assessing untrusted codebases.
